title: 5 Days Yoga Retreat in Canggu Bali
metaTitle: 5 Days Yoga Retreat In Canggu Bali
metaDescription: Retreat packages which includes fun-filled excursions, relaxing Ayurvedic massage sessions, lively kirtan nights through a 5 days yoga retreat in Canggu Bali.
summary: A 5 days / 4 nights yoga retreat in Canggu that you can start on any day of the week, following the weekly cycle of pranayama, Hatha, Dynamic Hatha Vinyasa, meditation, Yoga Nidra and sound baths.
intro: Five days in paradise isn’t just a retreat—it’s a complete lifestyle immersion. At Bali Yoga School in Canggu, our 5-day program offers the perfect duration to experience true transformation while exploring the full depth of our unique, flexible approach to authentic yoga practice.

Here’s what makes us different: while other retreats lock you into fixed schedules, we honor your individual journey. Choose to begin any day of our rich weekly cycle, creating your own adventure through ancient practices. You can perhaps begin on Friday with Nadi Shodhana pranayama and soft Hatha and go into the weekend dynamic sessions and sunset beach meditations, or on Tuesday with the invigorating Bhramari breath work and walking meditation in the mystery-filled Bali scenery.

Five days gives time to drastic changes. You will learn a variety of breathing exercises, including the cleansing Kapalabhati and the warming Surya Bhedi pranayama. Your practice will be developed in a combination of soft restorative Hatha and hard Dynamic Hatha Vinyasa. Sample the range of meditation: focused chanting of Om mantra, wide-ranging loving-kindness practices, body scans, and high-level chakra work.
